DFT calculations with dispersion corrections are better at reproducing the crystallographic Cu-Cu distances, whereas the B3LYP method without dispersion corrections better reproduces the experimental data for the other intramolecular distances.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of DFT-D3 is not recommended for Cu(I) complexes.
the use of B3LYP is not recommended for studying the structures of copper halide complexes.

the B3LYP and B3LYP-BJ (B3LYPD3) methods are both suitable for the study of the Cu2X2 to phosphine aryl LCT excited states, with the B3LYPD3 method giving the best overall performance for the calculation of the intramolecular metrics.
